summary: Dijksma Koudetechniek is a refrigeration, ventilation and electrical installer for crop stores, including ware and seed potato stores and crate storage. It is based in Emmeloord, Netherlands. It was founded in 1978 by Henk Dijksma senior and is a family business, fully owned by Henk Dijksma junior since 2005.
ownership: Family business, owned by Henk Dijksma junior since 2005
machines: Potato storage refrigeration: new build, renovation and expansion of cooling in barns for potatoes
Crate storage blow ventilation: air blown between crates or through the pallet opening
Crate storage suction ventilation: air drawn through crates to regulate potato storage
Cold cell electronics and controls: electronic and control part of storage cells
facts: Founded 1978 in Marknesse; moved to Emmeloord in 1993
Henk Dijksma junior joined in 1992, co-owner in 2000, full owner in 2005
Breakdown service available 24 hours a day
Also installs storage for onions, carrots, chicory roots and ULO fruit storage
